Data.String: R-201J to R-201P: typicals of R-201A (P-202), instrumented, steam-blocked and SIP-connected as R-201A; branch line numbers as R-201A's with the fermenter letter (D-035).
Each branch valve drawn stands for R-201A's steam block (two valves, SS between, CD bleed). Bottom SIP, sampling, the TW loop's CW and LP-steam injection and trips I-201 to I-204 as R-201A.
NOT AERATED (D-019): N2 overlay through F-202x, vent through F-201x. Fermenters 2.5 barg and full vacuum, 150 C (D-016, D-034). Sterile boundary at the branch valves (D-020).
